facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.title: unplanned release of pressure energy at ZV-7212

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on ZV-7212 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. ZV-7212 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 31 October 2004 a near hit was recorded on ZV-7212 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
